tagline: A party game of placing history on your own timeline. The game is not built yet.
player_form_intro: Pick the name and icon the others will see.
connection_failed: Couldn't connect. Check your connection and try again.
share_hint: Friends join with the code, the link or the QR code.
join_qr_code: QR code to join the game
refusal_invalid_name: Pick a name of 1 to 16 characters.
refusal_not_found: No running game has that code.
refusal_name_taken: Someone in this game already has that name.
refusal_icon_taken: Someone else took that icon. Pick another.
refusal_not_host: Only the host can do that.
refusal_host_cannot_leave: The host can't leave or be removed.
refusal_removed: The host removed you from this game.
removed_join_again: Join again if that was a mistake.
settings_host_only: Only the host can change these.
target_score_hint: The first to reach it wins ({min}–{max}).
country_cards_hint: Cards you almost have to have grown up in the country to know.
refusal_invalid_target_score: Pick a target score from {min} to {max}.
refusal_not_seating: The seating can't be changed right now.
refusal_not_picking: There's no category to pick right now.
refusal_not_your_pick: Someone else picks the category this time.
refusal_category_unavailable: There are no cards left in that category.
refusal_not_placing: There's no card to place right now.
refusal_invalid_slot: Pick a gap on your timeline.
refusal_lock_in_unavailable: You can lock in once you've placed a card correctly.
refusal_continue_unavailable: You can continue once you've placed a card correctly.
refusal_not_stealing: There's no card to steal right now.
refusal_not_your_steal: Someone else is stealing right now.
refusal_nothing_to_skip: That player isn't holding up the game right now.
refusal_no_other_reader: There's nobody else to read the card.
refusal_not_system: A game only ends this way after 24 hours with nobody playing.
refusal_too_few_players: You need at least two players to start.
refusal_stale_version: The game has moved on. Have another look and try again.
start_game_hint: You can start once at least one more player has joined.
waiting_for_host: Waiting for the host to start the game.
seating_host_hint: Arrange everyone the way you sit around the table.
seating_player_hint: The host is arranging the seating.
seating_let_go_to_cancel: Let go off the table to cancel
seating_your_neighbours: {left} is on your left, {right} on your right.
remove_from_game_confirm: {name} leaves the game for good, with their timeline, and can't come back to their seat.
end_early_confirm: The game ends now for everyone, with the scores as they stand, and nobody wins.
ended_early_hint: The game ended before anyone won.
abandoned_hint: Nobody played for a day, so the game ended with no winner.
